messages:
dana: Quick alignment thread  need a compact solution brief + two launch posts + webinar blurb for deploy-mode messaging (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Must include security highlights, SLA snapshot, and inbound routing CTA.
aj: I'll draft the one-pager and one social post. Need concrete SLA/latency lines from eng before finalizing claims.
sam: Field wants a single-row comparison: risk profile | SLA tier | recommended buyer. Keep it short.
ravi: I'll write the exec LinkedIn post and webinar summary. Please add a one-line ops quote about failover policy.
ops-bot: Reminder: Webinar "Deployment Modes for Regulated Workloads" scheduled 2026-05-07 09:00 PT. Register: https://events.redwood/dep-modes-2026
dana: Benchmarks: include a pullout: "mid-size chat (50k tokens/day) sees cost savings with batching + KV caching." Need ops confirmation on percent.
aj: One-pager outline: 1) TL;DR 2) Mode-at-a-glance (3 bullets each) 3) Security & compliance bullets 4) SLA snapshot (3-tier) 5) Benchmark callout 6) Field next steps + CTAs 7) Webinar link + FAQ.
sam: CTA for field: "Request a Dedicated Eval"; include "Start a Trial" for smaller teams.
ravi: Lead sentence suggestion: "Run reliable LLM inference where you need it  hosted, reserved, or in your network  with enterprise SLAs and controls." Avoid absolute latency claims.
aj: Proposed benchmark line: "mid-size chat (50k tokens/day)  up to 30% unit-cost reduction with batching and KV caching." ops to confirm.
ops-bot: Uploaded benchmark digest: /benchmarks/deploy_mode_summary.csv. Current samples show 20-30% savings depending on model and prompt shape.
dana: We'll use conservative "up to 30%" with footnote: "results vary by model, prompt, and sequence length."
ravi: Webinar slide asks: decision flow, security checklist, SLA excerpt, field intake steps.
aj: Field intake blurb: "Request Dedicated Eval: form -> security intake -> sizing -> 2-week trial -> decision". Sam to shorten for one-pager.
sam: Will compress to 3 lines and add expected timeline: 2-6 weeks depending on compliance docs.
ops-bot: Registered attendees: 5 (auto-update hourly).
dana: Please have first draft ready tomorrow 09:30 PT for review. React with :thumbsup: when done.
